The denominator of the average J of complete clones is C (completed and fully evaluated clones), not the planned number; when C = 0 there is no average, and it is not shown as 0
Confirmed life exits (E) are not in the average, nor in the simulation missing range; the exit and missing shares use the planned number of clones as their denominator

The denominator of the simulation missing range is C + M: known months are counted as they are, and the unknown part keeps everything from 0 to 1. It is not a confidence interval, nor a probability of real-world happiness

L is the average monthly satisfaction over the actual years; V is the valuation from the end state within reference life templates and treatment branches frozen in advance — not a prediction of the future, nor a global optimum; J combines the two by month weights
Missing data, unfinished planning, stops and program problems are simulation problems (M), not written up as “could not make a living in this city”
Reducing daily chores itself counts as convenience satisfaction; unscheduled free time earns no extra points

The event chain is written from checked environment records; it is not the model's reasoning, nor proof of cause; hard requirements are reported separately, without deducting points or removing anyone
Scores are computed under the current synthetic model from the stated preferences you confirmed; differences in the last decimal places do not make a reliable ranking
Cities, quotes, wages, taxes, illness and treatment are all synthetic settings; the results do not rank real cities and are not real-world recommendations
The offline planner is a controllable mock and does not represent a real large language model's ability or understanding of preferences
The questionnaire wording and reference improvement ranges are provisional drafts, not tested in cognitive interviews or validated as a scale
Leisure interests: you did not answer; this time it is not personalized by specific interests (evaluated with neutral rules)
Taste and cuisines: you did not answer; this time it is not personalized by specific cuisines (only fresh meals count)
Option catalog coverage only says whether the candidates surveyed within the declared scope have complete data; it does not guarantee that the whole city market was covered
Results are shown only to the user and are not fed back to clones still living
Life facts: E1 settlement records (money, jobs, housing, food, service months) and the monthly resource ledger (own household hours)
Areas, commuting, car access, device failures and tax: the single monthly commute record in E1's monthly resource ledger and the settlement records (not including the failure draws)
Evaluation: E1-6A per-clone intertemporal evaluation (L / V / J); summary: E1-6B city report (C / E / M, averages, simulation missing ranges, event chains, hard requirements)
Data: synthetic data pack pack.e3a.synthetic-v2 (f58ef477619f…) and the product protocol's base samples; everything is a synthetic setting

Controlled, deterministic offline planner (mock): it only tests wiring, state passing and information isolation and does not represent the abilities of a real large language model; no network calls, cost 0

notes.en: The valid range of mean_j is [0, 1] (minimum / maximum); a value outside it is a contract error, not something to clip
notes.zh: mean_j 的合法数值域是 [0, 1]（minimum / maximum）；超出这个范围是契约错误，不截断

notes.en: Per ADR 0045 the legend window may zoom within one result: all countries and both map modes of that result share one window and the legend states its two ends; it must not suggest that the lowest city scored zero or the highest scored full marks, and the scores and comparisons do not change
notes.zh: 图例窗口按 ADR 0045 在同一份结果之内适度放大：同一结果的所有国家、两种地图共用一个窗口，图例写明窗口两端；不暗示最低的城市是零分、最高的是满分，分数与比较结论不变

notes.en: When C = 0 or nothing was evaluated, do not draw the lowest colour; when there are simulation gaps (M) but a mean of the complete clones exists, colour it and show the number missing next to it
notes.zh: C = 0 或没有评价时不画最低分的颜色；有模拟缺失（M）但仍有完整者均值时照常着色，同时标出缺失人数

notes.en: The mean's denominator is mean_denominator (C, the clones that finished with a complete evaluation); the simulation-gap range uses C + M and is not a confidence interval
notes.zh: 均值的分母是 mean_denominator（完成且评价完整的分身数 C）；模拟缺失范围的分母是 C + M，它不是置信区间

notes.en: Compare only within this result; 0.7 does not mean being 70% happy in real life, and it is not a city recommendation or ranking
notes.zh: 只在这份结果之内比较；0.7 不表示现实里幸福 70%，也不是城市推荐或排名

limitations_zh: 城市、报价、工资、税、疾病与治疗全部是合成设定；结果不排序真实城市，也不是现实推荐
离线规划器是可控的 mock，不代表真实大语言模型的能力或偏好理解
问卷文案与参考改善范围是暂定稿，没有做认知访谈与量表验证
休闲兴趣：你没有回答，本次不按具体兴趣个性化（按中性规则评价）
口味与菜系：你没有回答，本次不按具体菜系个性化（只看新鲜餐）
选项目录覆盖只说明声明范围内调查过的候选资料齐不齐，不保证穷尽整个城市市场
结果只给用户看，不回灌给仍在生活中的分身

planner.description_zh: 可控的确定性离线规划器（mock）：只检验接线、状态传递与信息隔离，不代表真实大语言模型的能力；没有网络调用，费用为 0

reading_guide_zh: 完整者平均 J 的分母是 C（完成且评价完整的分身），不是原计划人数；C = 0 时没有平均值，不显示为 0
确认的生活出局（E）不进均值，也不进模拟缺失范围；出局与缺失的比例以原计划人数为分母
模拟缺失范围的分母是 C + M：已知的月份照算，未知部分在 0 到 1 之间都保留。它不是置信区间，也不是现实幸福的概率
L 是实际几年逐月满足感的平均；V 是从终态出发、在预先冻结的参考生活模板与治疗分支里的估值，不是对未来的预测，也不是全局最优；J 按月份权重合成两者
资料缺失、规划没有完成、停止与程序问题是模拟问题（M），不写成“在这座城活不下去”
减少日常杂务本身对应便利满足感；没有安排的空闲时间不额外加分
事件链按核对过的环境记录写成，不是模型的理由，也不是因果证明；硬要求单独报告，不扣分、不删人
分数是当前合成模型下、按你确认的陈述偏好计算的结果；小数末位的差异不构成可靠的排序
sources_zh: 生活事实：E1 结算记录（钱、岗位、住房、食品、服务月份）与月度资源账（本人家务小时）
片区、通勤、用车权、设备故障与税：E1 月度资源账里每月唯一的通勤记录与结算记录（不含故障抽签）
评价：E1-6A 单分身跨期评价（L / V / J）；汇总：E1-6B 城市报告（C / E / M、均值、模拟缺失范围、事件链、硬要求）
资料：合成资料包 pack.e3a.synthetic-v2（f58ef477619f…）与产品协议的基础样例；全部是合成设定
